title: Engagement Close And Space Repeat
description: When CAD engagement is finalized, close it instead of auto-starting same interaction. Space with no active engagement repeats last interaction across all UIs.
summary: Finalized CAD interactions now clear interactionId (close engagement) instead of leaving a stale id that Space restarted via repeatCurrentInteraction. Added EngagementInput.onRepeatLast with routeWindowEngagementSpace in @ui/react Mode/Engagement; CAD wires it to lastFinalizedInteractionId. Playground mirrors (CAD play, puzzle 2D/3D) route engagementRepeatLast through the command bus.
